questions.question: Where does God take his stand in Psalm 82?
options: On the battlefield, among the kings
In the divine council, among the gods/judges
In the holy temple courts, among all the priests
In the city gate, among the elders
questions.answer: In the divine council, among the gods/judges

questions.question: What does God command the rulers/judges to do?
options: Bring offerings up to the holy temple, both in the morning and the evening
Give justice to the weak, the fatherless, the afflicted, and the destitute
Faithfully keep all the feasts and the festivals appointed by the law
Subdue all of the nations and gather in tribute from their many kings
questions.answer: Give justice to the weak, the fatherless, the afflicted, and the destitute

questions.question: The psalm ends with a plea, 'Arise, O God, judge the earth; for you shall inherit all the nations!'
Give justice to the weak and the _____.
Arise, O God, _____ the earth; for you shall inherit all the nations!
